responsibility: Declares common tree SSA loop-analysis data structures and utility interfaces. It defines affine_iv and tree_niter_desc for describing induction variables and loop trip counts, and exposes helpers for iterating indices in memory references, generating temporary names for loop store-motion temporaries, estimating loop instruction counts, and mapping statements to their containing loops.
same_name_distinction: Defines common loop-analysis data structures and declarations, notably affine_iv and tree_niter_desc, plus prototypes for shared loop utilities. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa-loop.cc, it is the header describing common types and interfaces, not the implementation of loop pass scaffolding and helper routines.
